
## Read in the CSV
```{r}
getwd()
```

```{r}
asv_cecum <- read.csv("asv_core_cecum.csv")
asv_digesta <- read.csv("asv_core_digesta.csv")
asv_colon <- read.csv("asv_core_colon.csv")
asv_duo <- read.csv("asv_core_duodenum.csv")
asv_feces <- read.csv("asv_core_feces.csv")
asv_ileum <- read.csv("asv_core_ileum.csv")
asv_jej <- read.csv("asv_core_jejunum.csv")
asv_muc <- read.csv("asv_core_mucosa.csv")
```

```{r}
otu_cecum <- read.csv("otu_core_cecum.csv")
otu_digesta <- read.csv("otu_core_digesta.csv")
otu_colon <- read.csv("otu_core_colon.csv")
otu_duo <- read.csv("otu_core_duodenum.csv")
otu_feces <- read.csv("otu_core_feces.csv")
otu_ileum <- read.csv("otu_core_ileum.csv")
otu_jej <- read.csv("otu_core_jejunum.csv")
otu_muc <- read.csv("otu_core_mucosa.csv")
```

## Cecum
```{r}
asv_cecum |> 
  slice_max(prop_individuals, n = 10)
```
